verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline on one line as in the original, but it runs almost edge to edge with only ~28px side margins. There is also a large dead gap between the can and the headline, while the subcopy and CTA below are packed tightly together. B wraps the headline so 'fizz' is left alone on its own line, and the headline nearly touches the subcopy. That gives the bottom block an uneven, cramped rhythm. In both, the can now sits over the green circle, and the peach circle is shrunk to a small corner blob.
